scope: Original 20-run NASA aggregates and canonical trained-model CPU forward latency; no retraining or model selection.

nasa.error: prediction minus target; negative: expm1(-error/13), nonnegative: expm1(error/10)
nasa.primary: sum of per-engine penalties: target min(raw_RUL,125), prediction clip(q50,0,125)
nasa.secondary: primary/N_engines explicitly labeled per-engine mean; uncapped target and raw q50 separately labeled sensitivity
nasa.aggregation: arithmetic mean and sample SD (ddof=1) over five seed-level scores within each subset
nasa.historical_tolerance: float32 per-run totals rtol=1e-5, atol=0.002; rounded manuscript mean/SD atol=0.00051

latency.inputs: 100 official FD001 last-window inputs reconstructed from saved preprocessing, cycling in engine order
latency.execution: fresh subprocess per repetition; eval() and torch.inference_mode(); perf_counter_ns around forward only
latency.summaries: raw durations, mean, sample SD, median, p95, p99, repeat means and inverse-mean serial forward rate
latency.excluded: checkpoint loading, input preprocessing, IO, tensor slicing, conformal intervals and probability calibration
latency.parity: all 100 inputs, four outputs before timing; quantile atol=1e-3, probability atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5
latency.interpretation: this host only; no end-to-end, worst-case, real-time avionics, certification or edge feasibility claim; report both thread settings

external_review: REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE; executor reconstruction is not independent scientific review
